why_not_in_this_pr: config/lane_registry.json is operator-only (§17) and config/n8n_run_allowlist.json is being edited by other open PRs; this PR therefore carries the lane as a proposal and the operator applies it.
A scheduled LLM lane is also a spend decision: the runner's own $2/day cap and one-review-per-(PR,head) rule bound it, but the cadence is the operator's call.
apply_after: operator approval of the lane row
pr_title: [shared-infra] register the pr-independent-review lane (n8n, draft -> dry run -> shadow -> cutover)
scope_after_review: cc-deepseek-6's F1 (BLOCK at 6cb27e318): this PR shipped config/systemd/pr-review/tradeai-pr-review.{timer,service}, a five-minute systemd timer running the reviewer with --apply. House rule A is n8n-only, so the units are removed and the same work is expressed as one n8n lane proposal. Nothing about the reviewer's authority changes: it stays advisory, head-bound and unable to merge, label or approve anything.

house_rules.A_scheduled_by: n8n only; no systemd timer, no crontab line, and none left beside it
B_cutover_sequence: draft: the workflow exists, disabled, no schedule
dry run: scripts/pr_independent_review.py with no --apply lists the would-review set and the §29 preflight (credit journal, process cap, daily cap, provider cap) and calls no model
shadow: 72 hours at the real cadence, writing PrReview@v1 rows and labelling nothing
cutover: only after 72 clean shadow hours; a receipt names the lane, the first live run and the disable of any competing schedule
house_rules.C_sunset: the lane's own disable is recorded in the same receipt; nothing here re-enables it silently

steps: append registry_rows.json (one row) to config/lane_registry.json lanes[] -- operator, §17
append the allowlist entry to config/n8n_run_allowlist.json lanes[] in a separate shared-infra PR, with live_arg null until canary
operator: approve the pr_reviews store row in data_source_authority.json (D5) -- --apply refuses with STORE_APPROVAL_PENDING until then
operator: n8n dispatcher picks pr-independent-review from the registry at shadow; canary = --apply after 72 clean shadow hours
